scenes.text: You ask your AI to debounce a search box. It writes a hundred and sixteen lines.
Welcome to Claude Skills, by Curiously.
This is Ponytail, a free skill with over a hundred and ninety thousand stars on GitHub.
In the maker's own test, Claude without it built a helper, a wrapper and a config object.
Same prompt, same model, with Ponytail: ten lines. A timer is the debounce.
The trick is one short list. Before writing anything, Claude asks: does this need to exist? Is it already in your code, or built into the language? Only then does it write the minimum.
And it never cuts validation, error handling or security.
The catch: it's for coding only, and those numbers are the maker's own benchmark.
Install it with two commands. The link is in the description.
